title: Eval
subtitle: Choose office or coding harness first, then pick a suite. Each case binds one eval session and reuses Session Observation.
isolationNote: Live eval runs the production agent, one run at a time. Default suites keep MCP, browser, and public web search off. Imported business packs turn search on, copy Input fixtures, and allow 45–60 minutes per case. OmegaUse-OfficeVal copies office inputs, keeps search off, and allows 45 minutes per case; the local gate only checks whether a deliverable was written or edited — not an official rubric. Outputs stay in the eval workspace, never the desktop. Use office_core for office KPIs, OmegaUse-OfficeVal for long-horizon office tasks, and coding_local for coding KPIs.

taskProfile.hint: Office and coding are independent harnesses with different tools and scoring. The suite list follows the mode you pick.

empty.run: No run yet. Pick a harness and suite on the left, confirm the model, then Run.

casesHint: Select a row to inspect trajectory, scorers, and artifacts.
selectCase: Select a case on the left to inspect it.
historyHint: Select a row to open that run. Pick two runs when you need a diff.

officeval.note: Local gate: pass if an office file was edited or written. This is not an official OfficeVal score; official scoring needs the Python verifiers.

developerModeRequired: Turn on Developer Mode in Settings → System to use evals.
importHint: Pick the folder with T01 / T02 / T03 prompts. Import only creates the suite — it will not start a run.
importSuccess: Imported {{title}} ({{count}} cases). Confirm the cloud model, then Run.
importNotes: Web search on, Input binaries copied, 45–60 minute timeout, exactly one trial. Outputs stay in the eval workspace, not the desktop.
trialsLocked: Imported packs and OfficeVal always use 1 trial — no pass@k retries.
sandboxDisabled: This suite needs a sandbox runner and cannot be started locally.
reportConfirm: Upload a failure excerpt to the cloud (no full JSONL or raw prompt). Continue?
observationEmpty: No session observation yet (case has no conversation_id)

form.modelSelectTooltip: Model used by the live eval harness. Default uses the first enabled chat model.
form.modelUnavailableHint: This saved model is no longer available. Choose another model or Default Model.

report.title: Business pack report
report.modelNote: Cloud model for this run: {{model}} (recorded, not a comparison column)
report.empty: The three-column table appears after T01–T03 finish.
report.running: Run in progress. The three-column report appears after every case finishes.
report.footnote: Advisory checks do not affect case success. T03 arithmetic allows about 1% error.
report.stopGuide: Stop reason explains why the agent halted; it is not the pass/fail verdict. Normal stop = the model finished on its own. Truncated / max turns = a cap cut it off, so artifacts may be incomplete. Error = the eval process itself failed.
